corpus.title: Russians attack Zaporizhzhia again in evening: four injured
corpus.signal_text:
Russians attack Zaporizhzhia again in evening: four injured
Russian forces attacked a residential area in the city of Zaporizhzhia on the evening of 28 August, injuring four people.
Source: Ivan Fedorov, Head of Zaporizhzhia Oblast Military Administration; State Emergency Service of Ukraine
Details: Fedorov said Russia attacked a residential area.
Two men aged 65 and 40, a 17-year-old girl and a 68-year-old woman were injured.
The State Emergency Service reported that a house had been destroyed and a fire had broken out.
The blast wave and debris also damaged nearby houses and outbuildings.
Background: On the morning of 28 August, Russian forces attacked an Epicentr shopping centre in the city of Zaporizhzhia, sparking a fire that covered around 2,000 sq m and injuring four people.
